query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
           FROM chunk_file_ref fr
           JOIN chunk c ON c.id = fr.chunk_id
           WHERE c.user_id = $1
             AND ($2::text IS NULL
                  OR c.id IN (SELECT chunk_id FROM chunk_space WHERE space_id = $2)
                  OR c.id NOT IN (SELECT chunk_id FROM chunk_space))
